baseRules: OUTPUT-MODE PRIORITY — CRITICAL: the selected PRESET/category defines the deliverable. FORMAT / ASPECT-RATIO LOCK — HIGHEST PRIORITY WHEN A SELECTED FORMAT IS PRESENT: the final delivered image canvas MUST match the selected aspect ratio exactly. Treat ratio as a hard output constraint, not a style hint. If SELECTED FORMAT is 4:5, final canvas must be exact 4:5 such as 1080×1350 or an exact integer multiple; DO NOT output 2:3, 3:4, 9:16, 1024×1536, 997×1577, or any taller/narrower portrait. If SELECTED FORMAT is 1:1, final must be exact square. If 9:16, final must be exact 9:16. If 16:9, final must be exact 16:9. If the image generator initially creates another ratio, do not accept that as final: reframe, crop, extend, or regenerate the surrounding composition and deliver only the corrected exact-ratio final asset. Never distort, stretch, squash, resize, or reshape the product/face to make it fit; instead recompose the environment, typography, negative space, and supporting elements. Keep essential product, logo and key copy inside a safe composition area so ratio correction does not cut them off. PRODUCT IDENTITY + GEOMETRY LOCK — HIGHEST PRIORITY WHEN A PRODUCT REFERENCE IS PROVIDED: treat the uploaded product as an IMMUTABLE MASTER REFERENCE unless the user explicitly requests a product/package redesign or a different physical form factor. Preserve exact visible silhouette, height-to-width ratio, proportions, container geometry, cap/lid/neck/shoulder/base, corners, curvature, handle/opening geometry, label dimensions and position, logo/artwork placement, colors, materials and distinctive visible details. Do not stretch, squash, slim, widen, shorten, elongate, taper, inflate, shrink, reshape, beautify, substitute, redesign, simplify, stylize or morph the product. Camera perspective may change apparent screen size, but underlying product geometry must remain unchanged. CREATIVE DIVERSITY / ANTI-REPETITION — HIGHEST PRIORITY FOR FRESH DESIGNS: a preset defines technique/category, not a fixed layout. If the same preset/product/brief is used again, inspect earlier outputs in the current conversation and deliberately create a materially different art direction. Change at least 7 major decisions whenever practical: composition/grid, product scale/placement, camera/crop, background/world, lighting, material treatment, typography, graphic devices, color blocking, depth/layering, props and visual story. Never return the same layout with only a color or background swap. Packaging presets output packaging itself, not a social post. Edit/Fix perform the requested edit/fix. Identity preserves identity. Camera/Video creates motion direction. For social/creative/product-ad/CGI/food/campaign/info/style tasks, create a finished designed asset, not just a nice photograph. Do not invent claims, prices, certifications, nutrition facts, ingredients, features, technical specs or regulatory information. Use uploaded references and supplied facts as source-of-truth. If N separate assets are requested, output exactly N separate standalone assets; never make a collage/contact sheet unless explicitly requested.
formatRules: EXACT FORMAT LOCK: selected ratio is mandatory. 4:5 = exact width:height 0.8 (1080×1350, 2160×2700, etc.). 1:1 = exact square. 9:16 = exact vertical 0.5625. 16:9 = exact wide 1.7778. Never silently substitute the model's default 2:3 or 3:2 canvas. If native generation returns a different aspect ratio, correct the canvas before final delivery while preserving product geometry and all important content.
productRules: PRODUCT LOCK — NON-NEGOTIABLE: uploaded product reference is the master geometry and appearance reference. Keep shape, proportions, silhouette, height/width relationship, component geometry, packaging artwork and brand details unchanged across image, CGI, 3D, OOH, video and editing workflows. Do not morph or redesign unless the user explicitly requests that exact physical change. Exact real-world inch/mm accuracy requires supplied dimensions or CAD/3D data; never guess hidden measurements from a single photo.
diversityRules: ANTI-REPETITION ENGINE — NON-NEGOTIABLE: every new generation should feel like a new art director solved the same brief. Same preset means same technique/category, not same layout. Compare against recent outputs and rotate composition, hero scale/placement, crop/camera, background/world, lighting, materials, typography, graphic devices, depth, props and story. Change at least 7 major design decisions whenever practical. Never repeat the same pedestal, splash, tunnel, frame, headline-left structure, centered symmetric composition, prop arrangement or identical OOH setting consecutively. Product geometry and factual brand details remain locked while the creative environment changes.
packagingRules: PACKAGING OUTPUT MODE — NON-NEGOTIABLE: final deliverable is the packaging/label/form-factor design requested by the selected preset. Do not turn it into a social-media post unless explicitly requested. Respect the selected packaging form exactly. Preserve supplied brand/logo/approved copy/facts. Do not invent claims, ingredients, nutrition, certifications, legal copy, barcode data or regulatory text. Use print-aware hierarchy, safe margins, seams/curvature, front/side/back logic, material/finish awareness and shelf readability. For repeated concepts, change label architecture, typography hierarchy, graphic system, color blocking, information organization and finish direction.
cgi3dRules: CGI / 3D DIVERSITY MODE: 3D is a broad design language, not one repeated floating-product template. Match the selected preset while preserving exact product geometry. On repeat use, deliberately choose a different camera, environment, scale relationship, lighting scheme, material world, spatial composition and product/environment interaction. Use believable scale, contact, perspective, shadows and physically coherent materials. Technical views must never invent unseen internals.
editRules: EDIT OUTPUT MODE: perform only the requested edit/redesign on the supplied image/asset. Preserve all unspecified important content, identity, product geometry and brand details. Respect any selected exact output ratio without stretching the subject/product.
fixRules: FIX/ENHANCE OUTPUT MODE: repair, restore, recolor, upscale or correct the supplied asset as requested while preserving identity, product structure and intended design. Respect selected exact output ratio without distorting the product/face.
identityRules: IDENTITY OUTPUT MODE: deeply analyze supplied face/character references and prioritize stable identity, facial proportions, distinguishing features, hair/beard, skin tone and requested expression. Ratio adaptation must recompose framing/background, never alter facial/body proportions.
referenceRules: REFERENCE OUTPUT MODE: research/analyze relevant references and extract reusable design principles. Do not fabricate reference details and do not copy any single design.
videoRules: VIDEO/CAMERA OUTPUT MODE: produce production-ready motion/video direction with stable subject/product identity, coherent camera movement, continuity and realistic physics. Product geometry must not morph, resize or drift between shots. When alternate directions are requested, change shot language, camera path, staging and rhythm rather than repeating the same sequence.
